text: dsh-plugin-noticeme 是一款 DSH 网页端插件，会在后台页面出现待处理事项时提醒你。它在主机侧监听审批请求、用户提问调用和 agent 完成或出错事件，将提醒放入短期队列，再由浏览器客户端通过长轮询取回。页面隐藏时可显示桌面通知；浏览器通知不可用时会在标签标题前加上提示，回到页面后恢复。对于审批和提问提醒，插件会缓存可见期间收到的事项，并在切到后台时检查是否已处理，避免重复打扰。适合需要离开 DSH 页面但仍想留意审批、问题和任务结果的网页端用户。首次加载会请求浏览器通知权限，不需要 API key 或额外账号。

dsh-plugin-noticeme alerts DSH web users to approvals, questions, and agent results in hidden tabs. The host queues events for long polling. It shows desktop notifications or a tab-title marker and checks approval alerts. Notification permission is requested on first load; no API key is needed.
我切到别的标签页后，DSH 有审批要我点时能提醒我吗？
希望网页在后台时也能收到 DSH 的桌面通知。
让 DSH 的问题卡片出现时通知我回来回答。
DSH 标签页没有通知权限时，能不能用标题提示我有待确认事项？
我回到页面时，希望已经处理的审批不要再弹过期通知。
想知道 DSH agent 在后台跑完或出错了。
Notify me when a DSH approval needs my attention in another browser tab.
Can I get an alert when DSH asks me a question while I am away from the page?
dsh-plugin-noticeme 的功能「审批与提问提醒」：捕获待审批请求和 ask_user_question 调用并排入提醒队列。页面隐藏时显示桌面通知；可见时先缓存，切到后台再检查是否已处理后提醒。
dsh-plugin-noticeme 的功能「标题栏备用提示」：当浏览器通知不可用或无法创建时，在页面标题前加上需要确认的标记；页面重新可见或插件清理时恢复原标题。
dsh-plugin-noticeme 的功能「agent 任务结果提醒」：监听 agent 进入空闲状态并等待一段时间，若期间未恢复运行且没有等待用户决定，就提示任务完成；近期发生错误时会提示出错。
dsh-plugin-noticeme 的功能「后台长轮询」：浏览器客户端请求主机的等待接口，队列有新事项时立即返回，否则最多等待约 25 秒；队列读取后清空，避免同一事项反复提醒。
dsh-plugin-noticeme 使用浏览器 Notification API；首次加载时会请求通知权限。若权限不可用或通知创建失败，提醒会改用页面标题标记，需允许页面运行在支持相应浏览器 API 的环境中。

dsh-plugin-noticeme README · dsh-plugin-noticeme：Notify me when DSH needs me: desktop notification (with tab-title fallback) when an approval prompt or an ask-user-question card appears while the page is in the background.After testing, this plugin can implement notification functionality in a lightweight manner.

dsh-plugin-noticeme README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/this/pkg

dsh-plugin-noticeme README · published form:：dsh plugin add github:lw-storm/dsh-plugin-noticeme
```

Restart DSH after installing. On first page load the browser asks for notification
permission — allow it.

dsh-plugin-noticeme README · Behavior：- Watches `approval/request` (approval prompts) and `tools/result` for
  `ask_user_question` (question cards) on the host.
- Host keeps a short-lived queue, exposed at `GET /dsh-noticeme/pending`
  (same-origin only). Reading drains the queue: each item is notified once.
- Client polls every 3 s. While the page is visible nothing is shown; while
  hidden, a desktop `Notification` is raised (click → focus the page). If the
  Notification permission is unavailable, the tab title is prefixed with
  `⚠ 需要你确认 · ` and restored when the page becomes visible again.

dsh-plugin-noticeme README · Files：- `lib/index.js` — host entry (ESM, Node)
- `client/client.js` — browser entry (hand-written ModuleLoader bundle, no build step)
- `cordis.patch.yml` — profile layer insertion
